paper_title: FactBench A Dynamic Benchmark for In-the-Wild Language Model Factuality   Evaluation
caption: Distribution of LM's answer refusal categories on
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of categories in which large language models refuse to answer questions. The chart displays a total of six slices, representing six distinct categories: “Safety 1 (1.7%)”, “Safety (9.3%)”, “Misinformation 33 (38.4%)”, “Ethical Advice 14 (16.3%)”, “Lack of Knowledge 5 (83.3%)”, and “Clarification 12 (14.0%)”. The slices are ordered from largest to smallest in size, with 'Lack of Knowledge' occupying the largest portion of the chart. The chart includes percentage labels displayed within each slice, and no slices appear to be visually emphasized or exploded.
